purpose: Sources and record fields that judge a run. No run-time artefact (worker output, broker output, lesson, RCA fix) may write them; changes belong in reviewed development commits. Paths are repository-relative globs where ** matches zero or more segments. Fields are record keys that no lesson or fix may edit wherever they appear.

entries.covers: validators, gate checks and this manifest's checker
regression-trigger defaults and the per-run review threshold overrides
the decision gate, its provider registry and switches, review-point computation, run ceilings and raw-launch checks
attestation ranks, independence labels and the evidence queue a gate counts
provider modules whose presence activates a registered gate provider
scientific-judgment binding, agent graph, transport receipts, launch authorization, approval fingerprints, execution and machine leases
RDJ loop, anchor, custody, invariants and policy
what a role card must check, sees and may not read
review-point rows and their attachment to protocol stages
premise and trap predicates and their registry
the research protocol, its default definition and preregistered evaluator pins
ML metrics, receipt validation, cross-fit audit, exposure and custody
recomputed physics-review checks and their policy
the instructions, skills, rules, role definitions and checklists agents are judged against, the package metadata and the unit tests
this manifest, its tests, the lesson writer's do-not-learn hook and the enforcement surface

handoffs.wiring: Call is_protected on every broker or worker write before it lands; take evaluator_snapshot before and after each worker and store seal_worker_receipt's result; register the sealed receipt.
handoffs.until_wired: Seals are produced only by callers that choose to; an unsealed receipt is not refused at run time.

handoffs.consumer: review-point counting and RDJ receipt consumption
handoffs.wiring: review_points._receipt_records and rdj_custody.register_worker_receipt treat receipt_void_reason(receipt) as receipt_invalid, including evaluator_unsealed and evaluator_seal_malformed.
handoffs.until_wired: An evaluator-changed or unsealed receipt can still be credited by those consumers.

handoffs.wiring: Pass the registry's check ids as check_ids to knowledge_lessons.lesson_errors, so bare ids reach suppression_rule as known_ids, and refuse promotion on any do-not-learn finding.
handoffs.until_wired: A caller that omits check_ids gets only id-prefixed (check:, gate:, trap:, RP) and file or field matching.

handoffs.wiring: Run fix_errors with known_ids on every proposed fix and investigator_bundle on every check result an investigator sees; refuse the fix on any finding.
handoffs.until_wired: RCA fixes are refused only where a caller invokes fix_errors; the CI scan catches committed artefacts after the fact.
